stock.description: Operating as an investment holding entity, Renrui Human Resources Technology Holdings Limited offers a comprehensive suite of human resources services throughout China. Its operations are divided into key divisions: Comprehensive Flexible Staffing, Professional Recruitment, and Other Human Resources Solutions. The company's extensive offerings span general outsourcing, advanced digital technology and cloud services, and efficient digital operation and customer support. Additionally, it specializes in professional talent acquisition, business process outsourcing (BPO), corporate training programs, and labor dispatch services, alongside various other HR-related provisions. Established in 2010, Renrui's main office is located in Chengdu, China.
